CORAM:- URMILA JOSHI-PHALKE, J.
DATED :- JUNE 12, 2024.
Heard.
2. By this application, the applicant is seeking pre-arrest bail.

The applicant is apprehending arrest at the hands of police in connection with Crime No.295/2024 registered with police station Wathoda, Nagpur, District Nagpur for the offence punishable under Sections 368, 406, 420, 465,
467, 471 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the allegation the land bearing Khasra No.104/1/1 admeasuring 6 acres was belonging to the complainant Sandip Deogade and his mother.
In the year 2016, complainant Sandip and his mother has executed the deed of Power of Attorney in favour of co-accused Md. Rafique s/o Abdul.
Thereafter the complainant and his mother sold two acres of land through Power of Attorney in favour of Dipak Chopke and Madhukar Mate by executing sale-deed.
It is alleged that subsequently the complainant and his mother cancelled the deed of Power of Attorney which was in favour of co-accused Md. Rafique.
However, using earlier Power of Attorney co-accused Md. Rafique got executed the sale-deed of other two acres land in favour of the third person.
It is further alleged that the same land was again sold out to another person.
It is alleged that the present applicant stood as an attesting witness to the said sale-deed.
4. Learned Counsel for the applicant submitted that as far as present applicant is concerned only role attributed to him is that he stood as an attested witness to the said sale-deed.
He was not aware about the title of the landed property.
Being a friend he put his signature on the said sale-deed.
As far as his custodial interrogation is concerned which is not required.
In view of that, he be protected by granting ad-interim protection.

sentences.text: Learned Additional Public Prosecutor strongly opposed the application on the ground that the co-accused Md. Rafique not only executed the sale-deed in favour of third person but prior to that he has executed the sale-deed as a seller as well as a purchaser also and being present applicant aware about this fact in connivance with each other they have cheated the complainant and his friend, therefore, custodial interrogation is required.
Hence, the prayer for grant of ad-interim protection deserves to be rejected.
6. I have heard learned Counsel for both the parties.
Perused the recitals of the FIR.
As far as the role of the present applicant is concerned which is only to the extent of attesting witness on the said sale-deed.
As far as the contention of the learned APP is concerned that he is aware about the fact of executing the sale-deed fraudulently is a matter of investigation and the interrogation.

At this stage,
admittedly nothing is to be recovered from the present applicant.
As far as the part of the interrogation is concerned which can be taken care of by imposing certain conditions on the applicant.

In view of that, I proceed to pass following order:
(i) Issue notice to the non-applicant, returnable after two weeks.
(ii) Learned APP waives notice for the State.

(iii) In the event of arrest, the applicant - Iqbal Rashid Diwan in connection with Crime No.295/2024 registered with police station Wathoda,
Nagpur, District Nagpur for the offence punishable under Sections 368, 406, 420, 465, 467, 471 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, be released on ad-interim anticipatory bail on executing a P.R.Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one solvent surety, in the like amount.
(iv) The applicant shall attend the concerned police station once in a week i.e. on every Monday between 10.00 a.m. and 1.00 pm. and shall cooperate with the investigating agency.
(v) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement and threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the present case.
(URMILA JOSHI-PHALKE, J.) *Divya Iqbal Rashid Diwan vs The State Of Maharashtra Thr. Pso, Ps. ... on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157217719/
